audit.whatIsWrong: Five rows contradicted the page's own prose: level 1 was Irelia's though whys[0] says 'you concede this window and farm'; levels 3 and 4-5 were Jayce's though whys[2] and whys[3] describe your punish window; first item was Jayce's though whys[5] says force every all-in there; 2+ items was Jayce's though whys[6] says the lane settles back toward even.
audit.why: Gate-accelerated Shock Blast owns level 1, Flawless Duet at 3 turns the lane, and Jayce's damage plateaus while Irelia's on-hit ramps — the packet chart and the already-applied mirror agree on this shape.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 3, 5 and 6 set to Jayce, Irelia, Irelia, Irelia, Skill in both layers as one atomic group with matching ratings.

audit.why: Spikes correctly place his level 1-2 poke lead, your level-3 Flawless Duet punish, your level-6 Vanguard's Edge wall and your first-item Trinity spike; all four entries present.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[5], spikes[3] and mid credit Irelia with a passive armour shred she does not have. And nothing on the page mentions that Jayce's stance swap is a 6-second auto-attack reset whose first Cannon-form attack reduces your Armor and Magic Resist — that swap animation is the actual tell that his burst is starting.
audit.why: Riot's passive text for Ionian Fervor gives stacking attack speed and bonus on-hit at max stacks, no shred. Riot's R text gives the swap a 6s cooldown and the armour/MR reduction on the first attack after transforming.
audit.corrected: Shred language replaced with four-stack on-hit in whys[5] and spikes[3]; mid now names the 6s stance-swap reset and the armour/MR cut; Key Ability Interactions carries Shock Blast's 16s rank-1 timer and the swap tell.

edits.after: Your Trinity Force spike with full reset uptime and four-stack on-hit outpaces a poke champion whose damage has already plateaued — force every all-in here.

edits.before: Your core spike (Trinity Force) with full Bladesurge reset uptime and passive armor shred turns every gap-close lethal while his poke damage flatlines.
edits.after: Your core spike (Trinity Force) with full Bladesurge reset uptime and four-stack Ionian Fervor on-hit turns every gap-close lethal while his poke flatlines.

edits.before: This is my window. With Bladesurge passive online and cooldowns tightening, I out-stick anything Jayce can do at range — the second he hammer-swaps to combo me, I E-stun and ride Q-resets onto him while my Defiant Dance eats his burst. At 6 my R is the answer to his kiting: wall him into the terrain so he can't Thundering Blow me off, then run him down. He has no escape once the wall is down and my passive is shredding his resists.
edits.after: This is my window. With Ionian Fervor stacking and cooldowns tightening, I out-stick anything Jayce can do at range — the second he hammer-swaps to combo me, I E-stun and ride Q-resets onto him. Watch the swap animation, not the ability: his R is a 6s auto reset and the first Cannon-form hit cuts my armour and MR. At 6 my R walls him into terrain so Thundering Blow can't punt me off, and he has no escape.

edits.before: Track Jayce's Shock Blast: His main poke. Dodge it. When it is down — E-stun + Q him.
edits.after: Shock Blast is 16s at rank 1; his stance swap is a 6s auto reset — the wind-up is the tell.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Thundering Blow is 20s at rank 1 — commit once it is spent.
